title: Organisation
description: An organisation that interacts with the estate — legal firms, financial institutions, charities, dealers, funeral providers, employers, government bodies, and others. Maps to schema:Organization in JSON-LD

id.description: Unique identifier for this organisation within the INHERIT document

name.description: The organisation's legal or trading name

organisationType.description: The nature of the organisation. Use x-inherit- prefix for jurisdiction-specific or niche types not covered by the core enum
organisationType.$comment: legal_firm: solicitors, attorneys, notaries, licensed conveyancers, will writers. financial_institution: banks, building societies, investment platforms, stockbrokers. pension_provider: workplace pensions, personal pensions, SIPPs, CPF/EPF. insurance_provider: life, home, asset, health, motor insurance. dealer: specialist dealers in antiques, collectibles, art, wine. auction_house: auction houses and salerooms. valuation_firm: professional valuers and surveyors. funeral_provider: funeral directors, crematoriums, memorial services. charity: registered charities, foundations, charitable trusts. religious_institution: mosques, temples, churches, synagogues, gurdwaras. employer: current or former employers. trust_corporation: corporate executors and trustee services. accountancy_firm: accountants and tax advisers. government_body: tax authorities, probate registries, land registries, charity commissions. retailer: retailers from whom items were purchased (provenance). manufacturer: makers of items (warranty, specifications, product pages). property_management: leasehold management companies, strata corporations. storage_facility: self-storage and specialist storage providers. digital_platform: social media platforms, cloud storage, cryptocurrency exchanges. utility_provider: electricity, gas, water, broadband, mobile providers. other: any organisation not covered by the above.

estateRoles.description: The roles this organisation plays in this specific estate. An organisation may play multiple roles

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction where this organisation operates. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code

wikidataId.description: Wikidata Q-number for this organisation, enabling linked data resolution. Many major organisations have Wikidata entries with structured data (founding date, parent company, headquarters, etc.)
wikidataId.$comment: Q2402878 = HMRC, Q4424418 = Macmillan Cancer Support, Q5277509 = Dignity plc. Resolve via https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:EntityData/{Q-number}.json

description.description: Brief description of the organisation and its relevance to this estate
examples: Family solicitor since 2018. Handled the purchase of 42 Oak Lane.

registrations.description: Registrations with regulatory bodies, professional associations, and government registries. An organisation may hold multiple registrations across jurisdictions

contactPerson.description: Name of the primary contact person at this organisation for estate matters
examples: Dave at the model railway desk

notes.description: Free-text notes about this organisation's relationship to the estate
examples: Contact Dave at Manchester Model Railway Club — he knows the right dealers. Do not sell on eBay individually.
Margaret's employer. Death-in-service benefit: 4x salary. HR contact: Jane Williams.

ratings.description: Aggregate ratings from review platforms. One entry per platform. Supports user decision-making, agent filtering/ranking, and point-in-time audit trails

ratingValue.$comment: Maximum is 10 to accommodate Checkatrade's 10-point scale. Most platforms use 1–5. Cross-field validation (ratingValue <= bestRating) is application-side — JSON Schema cannot express cross-field constraints

bestRating.description: Maximum possible score on this platform. Default 5 if absent

worstRating.description: Minimum possible score on this platform. Default 1 if absent

reviewCount.description: Total number of reviews on this platform

profileUrl.description: URL to the organisation's profile on this platform

retrievedAt.description: When this rating data was retrieved or verified

sameAs.description: URIs identifying this entity elsewhere (schema.org sameAs). e.g. Wikidata, LinkedIn, DBpedia

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

vatConfiguration.description: The organisation's VAT registration status and scheme. Affects how VAT is calculated on transactions involving this organisation

vatRegistered.description: Whether the organisation is VAT registered

vatScheme.description: Which VAT scheme the organisation uses. Only relevant if vatRegistered is true

vatCountry.description: The country of VAT registration, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

internationalShipping.description: International shipping capabilities and policies for this organisation

shipsToCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this organisation ships to

receivesFromCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this organisation receives items from

customsHandling.description: Whether this organisation handles customs declarations for international shipments

importDutyPolicy.description: Who pays import duties on international transactions

currency.description: The primary currency this organisation trades in, as ISO 4217

identifiers.description: External identifiers — charity number, company registration, UEN, etc.

dealerProfile.description: Dealer-specific profile information. Only relevant for organisations that operate as dealers on marketplace or catalogue platforms

categories.description: Asset categories this dealer specialises in

dealerTier.description: The dealer's subscription tier on the platform

fulfilmentCapabilities.description: Physical services this dealer can provide

averageResponseTime.description: Typical time to respond to a valuation request or offer

Registration.description: A registration with a regulatory body, professional association, or government registry

body.description: The regulatory body or registry. Use an id from well-known-organisations.json where available, or a descriptive string for unlisted bodies

number.description: The registration number. Format varies by body — see well-known-organisations.json for expected patterns

status.$comment: active: currently registered and in good standing. suspended: temporarily suspended by the regulatory body. revoked: registration has been revoked or struck off. voluntary: voluntary membership (not statutory regulation). expired: registration has lapsed or not been renewed.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction this registration applies to. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code

verificationUrl.description: URL to verify this registration with the regulatory body

verifiedAt.description: When this registration was last verified

liveCheck.description: Result of a live API check against this registry. Snapshot at retrievedAt. Registry-specific fields are validated conditionally based on the parent body field

companyStatus.$comment: active: company is active and trading. dissolved: company has been dissolved. liquidation: company is being wound up. receivership: company is in receivership. administration: company is in administration. voluntary-arrangement: company has a voluntary arrangement. converted-closed: company has been converted or closed

sicCodes.description: Standard Industrial Classification codes from Companies House

accountsOverdue.description: Whether accounts are overdue at Companies House

insolvencyFlag.description: Whether there are active insolvency proceedings

authorisationStatus.$comment: authorised: firm is authorised to conduct regulated activities. revoked: authorisation has been revoked. suspended: authorisation temporarily suspended. cancelled: firm requested cancellation. no-longer-authorised: authorisation lapsed or withdrawn

permissions.description: Regulated activities the firm is authorised for

charityStatus.description: Charity Commission or OSCR registration status
charityStatus.$comment: registered: charity is registered and active. removed: charity has been removed from the register. suspended: charity operations suspended by the regulator. in-default: charity has failed to meet reporting requirements

income.description: Latest reported annual income in minor units (pennies/cents)

reportingStatus.description: Whether the charity's reporting is up to date
reportingStatus.$comment: up-to-date: all required filings submitted on time. overdue: one or more required filings are late. not-required: reporting is not required for this entity
